Description:
This is a sample storymap. Each block of text is a chapter: one row in the file csv/Chapters.csv. Scroll down, or click a marker, to move through the story.

The sample visits four of the eight Early Christian monuments of Ravenna, inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 1996. Replace every row with your own places, texts and images.

Description: Sample text. A small cross-shaped building of the fifth century, a few steps from San Vitale, with a mosaic vault of stars on a deep blue ground.

Description: Sample text. Built as the palace church of Theodoric in the early sixth century. Long mosaic processions of martyrs and virgins run along both sides of the nave.
